fields.regle: although / though / even though sont suivis d'une proposition (sujet + verbe). in spite of / despite sont suivis d'un nom ou d'un -ing. Jamais « despite of ».

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Bien qu'il ait plu, la fiesta a eu lieu.

accepted: Although it rained, the fiesta went ahead
Even though it rained, the fiesta went ahead

exercises.prompt: Traduis avec despite : Malgré la pluie, la fiesta a eu lieu.

accepted: Despite the rain, the fiesta went ahead
In spite of the rain, the fiesta went ahead

hints: Un nom suit despite, sans « of ».

exercises.prompt: Traduis avec in spite of : Malgré son manque d'expérience, elle a obtenu le poste.

accepted: In spite of her lack of experience, she got the job
Despite her lack of experience, she got the job

exercises.prompt: ___ the deadline was tight, nobody worked at the weekend.

accepted: Although
Though
Even though

exercises.prompt: She took the role ___ being warned about the workload.

accepted: despite
in spite of

exercises.source: Although he was tired, he stayed for the town hall.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « in spite of ».

accepted: In spite of being tired, he stayed for the town hall
In spite of his tiredness, he stayed for the town hall

hints: Il faut un nom ou un -ing après in spite of.

exercises.source: Despite of the delay, the client renewed the contract.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: Despite the delay, the client renewed the contract
In spite of the delay, the client renewed the contract

exercises.prompt: ___ the guardrails were in place, the model still leaked data.

accepted: Even though

hints: Sujet + verbe : il faut une conjonction.

fields.regle: in case dit la précaution prise d'avance, et se construit au présent : « Take an umbrella in case it rains. » Ce n'est pas if : if pose une condition, in case anticipe un risque.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Prends une copie au cas où le portable planterait.

accepted: Take a copy in case the laptop crashes

hints: Présent après in case, jamais will.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Je te laisse mon numéro au cas où tu aurais besoin de moi.

accepted: I'll leave you my number in case you need me

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Nous avons gardé l'ancienne version au cas où.

accepted: We kept the old version just in case

hints: « just in case » peut clore la phrase.

exercises.prompt: Write the handover now ___ you are off sick next week.

accepted: in case

exercises.prompt: I'll take my laptop in case they ___ a live demo. (want)

accepted: want

exercises.source: The server might fail, so we run a nightly backup.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « in case ».

accepted: We run a nightly backup in case the server fails

hints: La précaution vient d'abord, le risque après.

exercises.source: Take an umbrella in case it will rain.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: Take an umbrella in case it rains

hints: Jamais de will après in case.

exercises.prompt: Laquelle exprime une précaution, pas une condition ?

accepted: I'll book two rooms in case Anna comes

distractors: I'll book two rooms if Anna comes
I'll book two rooms unless Anna comes
I'll book two rooms when Anna comes
hints: On réserve d'avance, avant de savoir.

fields.regle: unless = if not. as long as / provided (that) / providing posent une condition stricte. Tous se construisent au présent pour parler du futur.

exercises.prompt: Traduis avec unless : Je n'irai pas, à moins qu'ils ne paient le déplacement.

accepted: I won't go unless they pay for the travel

hints: unless remplace « if not » : pas de seconde négation.

exercises.prompt: Traduis avec as long as : Tu peux emprunter la voiture, à condition de la rendre lundi.

accepted: You can borrow the car as long as you bring it back on Monday

exercises.prompt: Traduis avec provided : Nous signerons, à condition que le périmètre soit écrit noir sur blanc.

accepted: We will sign provided the scope is written down
We will sign provided that the scope is written down

exercises.prompt: ___ you ask, nobody will tell you the day rate.

accepted: Unless

exercises.prompt: I'll present it as long as somebody ___ the questions. (take)

accepted: takes

exercises.source: If you don't book a desk, you will have to stand all day.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « unless ».

accepted: Unless you book a desk, you will have to stand all day

exercises.source: Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the last train.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: Unless you hurry, you will miss the last train

hints: Double négation : unless veut déjà dire « if not ».

exercises.prompt: We'll ship on Thursday ___ the tests pass.

accepted: provided

hints: C'est une condition à remplir, pas un risque à écarter.

fields.regle: as dit la simultanéité (« as I walked home ») ou la cause (« as it was late, we left »). Au sens temporel, as insiste sur deux actions qui se déroulent ensemble, while sur une durée.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Comme il pleuvait, nous avons pris un taxi.

accepted: As it was raining, we took a taxi

hints: as au sens causal, en tête de phrase.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Le téléphone a sonné au moment où je sortais.

accepted: The phone rang as I was leaving

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Comme personne n'était disponible, la réunion a été reportée.

accepted: As nobody was available, the meeting was postponed

exercises.prompt: ___ I was walking along the harbour, I met my old manager.

accepted: As
While

exercises.prompt: ___ the budget had already been signed off, nobody argued.

accepted: As
Since

exercises.source: Because the lift was out of order, we used the stairs.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « as ».

accepted: As the lift was out of order, we used the stairs

hints: as remplace because, en tête de phrase.

exercises.source: As I was young, I lived in Cardiff for two years.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase pour dire « quand j'étais jeune ».

accepted: When I was young, I lived in Cardiff for two years

hints: Pour une période de la vie, c'est when.

exercises.prompt: ___ the model was training, we prepared the demo.

accepted: While

hints: Une durée pendant laquelle autre chose se passe.

fields.regle: like + nom ou pronom (« like a bank »). as + proposition (« as I said ») ou fonction réelle (« she works as a nurse » : elle l'est vraiment). « like a nurse » voudrait dire qu'elle ne l'est pas.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Il travaille comme consultant depuis dix ans.

accepted: He has worked as a consultant for ten years

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Cette pièce ressemble à un entrepôt.

accepted: This room looks like a warehouse

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Comme je te l'ai dit hier, le périmètre a changé.

accepted: As I told you yesterday, the scope has changed

exercises.prompt: She used the old server ___ a test machine for months.

accepted: as

exercises.prompt: He talks ___ his father — same pauses, same jokes.

accepted: like

exercises.source: I did the report the way you asked.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « as ».

accepted: I did the report as you asked

exercises.source: Like I said in the meeting, the pilot is not a product.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase en registre soigné.

accepted: As I said in the meeting, the pilot is not a product

hints: Une proposition suit : as, pas like.

exercises.prompt: She was hired ___ a workplace consultant, not as an architect.

accepted: as

fields.regle: as if / as though + proposition décrivent une apparence : « It looks as if it is going to rain. » Pour une hypothèse contraire aux faits, le verbe recule : « He talks as if he knew everything » (il ne sait rien).

exercises.prompt: Traduis : On dirait qu'il va pleuvoir.

accepted: It looks as if it is going to rain
It looks as though it is going to rain

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Elle parle comme si elle dirigeait le projet — ce n'est pas le cas.

accepted: She talks as if she ran the project
She talks as though she ran the project

hints: Fait contraire à la réalité : le verbe recule au prétérit.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Il avait l'air de ne pas avoir dormi.

accepted: He looked as if he had not slept
He looked as though he had not slept

exercises.prompt: It sounds ___ the migration has been postponed again.

accepted: as if
as though
like

exercises.prompt: He behaves as if he ___ the only person in the room. (be)

accepted: were
was

exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase en commençant par « She looks as if ».

accepted: She looks as if she is tired
She looks as if she has been working too hard

hints: Une proposition complète après as if.

exercises.source: He speaks as if he would be the manager.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: He speaks as if he were the manager
He speaks as if he was the manager

hints: Pas de would après as if : le verbe recule d'un cran.

exercises.prompt: The office smells ___ somebody has burnt the toast.

accepted: as if

fields.regle: during + nom dit quand (« during the meeting »), for + durée dit combien de temps (« for two hours »), while + proposition (« while I was reading »).

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Il n'a rien dit pendant la réunion.

accepted: He said nothing during the meeting

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Nous avons attendu pendant deux heures.

accepted: We waited for two hours

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Elle a pris des notes pendant que je présentais.

accepted: She took notes while I was presenting

exercises.prompt: Nobody touched the code ___ the summer.

accepted: during

exercises.prompt: The lift was out of order ___ three weeks.

accepted: for

exercises.source: I read the report during my journey home.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la phrase avec « while ».

accepted: I read the report while I was travelling home

hints: while demande un sujet et un verbe.

exercises.source: She lived in Bristol during six years.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: She lived in Bristol for six years

hints: Une durée chiffrée n'est jamais introduite par during.

exercises.prompt: Two people left ___ the presentation.

accepted: during

fields.regle: until dit qu'une situation dure jusqu'à un moment ; by dit qu'un événement aura lieu au plus tard à ce moment. « by the time » introduit une proposition.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Je serai au bureau jusqu'à six heures.

accepted: I will be in the office until six

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Envoie-moi les chiffres pour vendredi au plus tard.

accepted: Send me the figures by Friday

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Le temps que j'arrive, tout le monde était parti.

accepted: By the time I arrived, everybody had left

hints: by the time + proposition, et past perfect derrière.

exercises.prompt: The shop stays open ___ nine on Thursdays.

accepted: until
till

exercises.prompt: The contract has to be signed ___ the end of the month.

accepted: by

exercises.source: I waited. Then, at last, she called at four.
exercises.prompt: Réécris en une phrase avec « until ».

accepted: I waited until she called at four

exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: Please answer by Monday morning

exercises.prompt: ___ the audit started, half the team had already resigned.

accepted: By the time
